name: Oak and Orca Bioregional School (and Oak and Orca School online learning)

geo.coord_source: BC Ministry school-location dataset 2025/2026 (DataBC geocode of the registered address)

description: Victoria independent school founded 1999 offering an on-site K–12 'open classroom' bioregional programme (multi-age, non-graded, child-led inquiry) and a separate Group 1 provincial online learning school ('Hands-On Home-Learning') for home learners across B.C., with blended 1–4 day options and a forest-school day.

attributes.philosophy: Open classroom: multi-age, non-graded, emergent curriculum, child-directed choice between teacher-led workshops and self-directed activities; bioregional (place-based) education. High school by mentor-planned inquiry projects mapped to ministry standards.

legal_status.label: Independent school, Group 1 (on-site school and separate online learning school)
legal_status.authority: B.C. Ministry of Education and Child Care — Independent Schools Branch

attributes.grades: Pre-primary and K–12 on site; K–12 online learning (home learning)
attributes.curriculum: B.C. curriculum met through inquiry and interest-based projects.
attributes.qualifications_offered: B.C. Dogwood through the high-school programme (first graduation 2014 reported by the school).
accreditation: Listed by the Ministry as an independent online learning school

tuition.notes: On-site full time: $250–$400 per month on a sliding scale, September–June (≈$2,500–$4,000/yr, computed), plus $100 activity fee. Blended on-site add-on for online-learning students: $1,050–$1,200/yr (1 day/week), $1,875–$2,175/yr (2 days/week). The page does not state the school year. Online (home-learning) enrolment fee not stated.

attributes.class_size: Low student-teacher ratio stated; no figures.
advantages: Genuinely learner-directed, non-graded model with a Dogwood pathway
Online learning school lets families anywhere in B.C. enrol and blend with on-site days
limitations: Tuition page carries no school-year label
attributes.qualifying_reason: Model and legal status verified (official site, B.C. register, ministry list of independent online learning schools), but the published tuition has no school year, so the record cannot be marked verified under SPEC §7. Strong candidate: confirm the fee year with the school.

sources.publisher: B.C. Ministry of Education and Child Care

limitations: Tuition year missing; annual figure computed from the monthly range over ten months.
